findings.evidence: Mathlib gives only `real_inner_smul_self_left (x : F) (r : ℝ) : ⟪r • x, x⟫_ℝ = r * (‖x‖ * ‖x‖)` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Basic.lean:624), so the `‖n‖ = 1` cleanup is not in the library; grep for `real_inner_smul_self_left` in the diff returns Rapidity.lean:117,131 and InvariantMass.lean:126,138,228.
findings.fix: Add one lemma next to `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_mul_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` in MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean, with the same hypothesis shape: `lemma inner_spatialPart_eq_of_spatialPart_eq_smul {d} {v : Vector d} {n} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) {a : ℝ} (hv : v.spatialPart = a • n) : ⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ = a := by rw [hv, real_inner_smul_self_left, hn]; ring`, and use it at all five sites. It is also the bridge a downstream user needs to get from a collinear hypothesis to the `|⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ| < v.timeComponent` hypothesis of `exp_rapidity`/`exp_two_mul_rapidity`, which InvariantMass.lean currently redoes by hand each time.
findings.issue: The projection `⟪a • n, n⟫_ℝ = a` for `‖n‖ = 1` is re-derived five times by the same `rw [..., real_inner_smul_self_left, hn]` + `ring`/`linear_combination` step: Rapidity.lean:117 and :131 are verbatim identical (`have hpar : ⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ = a := by rw [hv, real_inner_smul_self_left, hn]; ring`), and InvariantMass.lean:126-128, :137-138 and :227-229 repeat it for `q`, `q + P` and `γ.energy • n`.

findings.evidence: Kinematics/Basic.lean:107-109 already hosts the companion `one_sub_energyFraction_mul_energy`, proved with the same `div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs`, so the simpler identity belongs there rather than being re-derived in the downstream file.
findings.fix: Name it once in Kinematics/Basic.lean beside its existing companion: `theorem PhotonKinematics.energyFraction_mul_energy (k : PhotonKinematics) {s : ChargedSource} (hs : s.energy ≠ 0) : k.energyFraction s * s.energy = k.energy := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs`, and use it at both sites (it also shortens `one_sub_energyFraction_mul_energy`).
findings.issue: `γ.energyFraction s * s.energy = γ.energy` is derived inline twice by the identical two-step proof: line 213-214 (`rw [..., PhotonKinematics.energyFraction_def, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs]`) and lines 224-225 (`have hx : γ.energyFraction s * s.energy = γ.energy := by rw [PhotonKinematics.energyFraction_def, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs]`).

summary: The rapidity definition and the invariant-mass relations are genuinely new and reuse Mathlib's artanh API correctly. Two computations are re-derived instead of being named once: the unit-axis projection ⟪a • n, n⟫ = a (five sites across both files) and x·E_s = γ.energy (two sites), the latter despite an existing companion lemma in Kinematics/Basic.lean.
